title: Review the README before the 0.4.0 release
body: The storage and sync section says how schemas work now: migrated on read, the ref taken to the foam's schema on the first write with a message, the gate and the window, stats and doctor showing the schema. The show example carries a note id. Every command and flag still matches --help; only stats changed.
close_reason: schemas paragraph added, stats sentence and the show example updated; commands unchanged since 0.3.0 except stats
